crossbow.gravity.label: Bolt drop
crossbow.gravity.help: Downward acceleration in metres per second squared.

crossbow.bolt_cap.label: Embedded bolt limit
crossbow.bolt_cap.help: Oldest embedded bolt is removed above this limit.

grapple.reel_speed.label: Reel speed
grapple.reel_speed.help: Continuous pull speed; release trigger to pause.

crossbow.trigger_break.label: Trigger break
crossbow.trigger_break.help: Analog pressure needed to release the sear. Release below 0.15 to reset.

crossbow.bolt_speed.label: Bolt speed
crossbow.bolt_speed.help: Base bolt velocity; a Brann per-item live profile overrides this.

crossbow.crank_reach.label: Crank grip reach
crossbow.crank_reach.help: Hand distance from the winding knob needed to grab it.

crossbow.load_reach.label: Bolt seating reach
crossbow.load_reach.help: Forgiving rail catch distance; the bolt must also point along the rail.

crossbow.damage.label: Bolt damage
crossbow.damage.help: Base impact damage; a Brann per-item live profile overrides this.

enemy.stride.label: Stride length
enemy.stride.help: Animation stride multiplier; gait follows actual travel.

enemy.windup.label: Attack wind-up
enemy.windup.help: Seconds before the visible strike; applies on next attack.

enemy.recovery.label: Attack recovery
enemy.recovery.help: Recovery seconds after a strike; applies on next attack.

enemy.recoil.label: Hit reaction
enemy.recoil.help: Cosmetic recoil strength, not gameplay stagger.

enemy.death_scatter.label: Death scatter
enemy.death_scatter.help: Impulse multiplier for physical character pieces.

grip.secondary_reach.label: Second hand reach
grip.secondary_reach.help: Distance from the handle for a support grip or regrip.

grip.smoothing.label: Held-object steadiness
grip.smoothing.help: Subtly damps VR hand-held jitter. Zero keeps exact tracking; larger deliberate motions stay responsive. Desktop and head tracking are unchanged.

holster.reach.label: Holster reach
holster.reach.help: Distance from a hip slot to store or retrieve tools.

holster.height.label: Hip offset
holster.height.help: Distance below the headset to the estimated belt.

input.grip_press.label: Grip to grab
input.grip_press.help: Squeeze value needed to begin grabbing. Release is clamped below this value.

input.grip_release.label: Release earlier
input.grip_release.help: Higher values release earlier as your fingers open. Effective maximum is grab threshold minus0.05.

hands.pitch_degrees.label: Hand pitch
hands.pitch_degrees.help: Visual hand and held-tool pitch correction.

hands.yaw_degrees.label: Hand yaw
hands.yaw_degrees.help: Visual hand and held-tool yaw correction.

hands.roll_degrees.label: Hand roll
hands.roll_degrees.help: Visual hand and held-tool roll correction.

player.eye_height.label: Target eye height
player.eye_height.help: Eye height used when you press Calibrate height.

bomb.formation_seconds.label: Formation time
bomb.formation_seconds.help: Seconds to form a ready bomb.

bomb.radius.label: Bomb radius
bomb.radius.help: Visual and collision radius in metres.

throw.gain.label: Throw gain
throw.gain.help: Multiplier applied to sampled hand velocity.

throw.window_seconds.label: Sampling window
throw.window_seconds.help: Strongest recent hand motion retained for a forgiving release.

throw.assist_lift.label: Release lift
throw.assist_lift.help: Upward assistance in metres per second.

throw.min_speed.label: Throw threshold
throw.min_speed.help: Below this hand speed, release drops instead of launching.

throw.max_speed.label: Speed limit
throw.max_speed.help: Maximum launch velocity in metres per second.

bomb.impact_delay.label: Impact delay
bomb.impact_delay.help: Seconds between first impact and detonation.

bomb.damage.label: Bomb damage
bomb.damage.help: Damage to enemies within the blast radius.

bomb.self_damage_ratio.label: Self damage
bomb.self_damage_ratio.help: Player damage fraction relative to enemy damage.

vfx.intensity.label: Effect intensity
vfx.intensity.help: Overall explosion brightness and scale emphasis.

haptics.strength.label: Haptic strength
haptics.strength.help: Global multiplier; final device amplitude stays bounded.

locomotion.speed.label: Movement speed
locomotion.speed.help: Left-stick VR and desktop movement speed in metres per second.

playful.ring_toss_gain.label: Ring toss strength
playful.ring_toss_gain.help: Sunskipper launch multiplier; applies on next toss, capped at 21 metres per second.

playful.ring_gravity.label: Ring drop
playful.ring_gravity.help: Sunskipper downward acceleration in metres per second squared; changes during flight.

playful.ring_recall_speed.label: Ring recall speed
playful.ring_recall_speed.help: Sunskipper return speed in metres per second; changes during recall.

playful.magnet_range.label: Wand reach
playful.magnet_range.help: Maximum cargo acquisition distance in metres; lowering it also releases distant held cargo.

playful.magnet_pull.label: Wand pull acceleration
playful.magnet_pull.help: Maximum cargo acceleration in metres per second squared; lower values make distant pulling gentler.

playful.magnet_fling.label: Wand toss speed
playful.magnet_fling.help: Forward cargo fling speed in metres per second; final combined velocity stays below 6.

playful.ring_curve.label: Ring banking curve
playful.ring_curve.help: Sideways turn strength at full bank; flat throws stay straight.

playful.ring_recall_accel.label: Ring recall pull
playful.ring_recall_accel.help: Acceleration pulling momentum back towards the hand; no instant reversal.

playful.ring_bounce.label: Ring bounce energy
playful.ring_bounce.help: Speed retained after mirror-angle scenery ricochets.

worldbuilder.mana_regen_multiplier.label: Mana recovery speed
worldbuilder.mana_regen_multiplier.help: World Builder Mana recovery relative to the original 0.055 Mana per second. Four is the testing pace.
